reason: I already follow the Tawfeer offers and drive down when there is a deal, so I stock up myself. Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time and then collecting between 6 and 8 does not fit how I shop.
objection: Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time is a hassle, and I would not see the shelf price or the offer myself. Paying their till price plus $2 a bag, I have to trust that they really found the cheapest.
would_change_my_mind: If they showed me, with a receipt, that my basket came out clearly cheaper than my own shop, and I could send the list later in the day.
